contracts.why_load_bearing: always() on a staging Docker step defeats fail-closed propagation

contracts.protected_invariant: the staging aggregate refuses a forged-PASS record and a tampered record whose token no longer matches
contracts.proving_mutation: make the aggregate accept a record without re-validating; a forced-clean staging aggregate passes
contracts.why_load_bearing: the staging aggregate is the whole-chain verdict for both images

contracts.protected_invariant: the cross-workflow battery baseline has both real publication workflows at graph PASS
contracts.proving_mutation: break either integrated workflow; the baseline is no longer both-PASS
contracts.why_load_bearing: the whole battery is meaningless if the baseline is not clean

contracts.linked_behaviour: the cross-workflow harness exposes exactly 32 unique scored arms
contracts.protected_invariant: the scored battery has exactly 32 unique arm IDs 1..32
contracts.proving_mutation: drop or duplicate an arm; the count/uniqueness assertion fails
contracts.why_load_bearing: a battery that silently loses an arm proves less than it claims

contracts.linked_behaviour: every scored arm activates and reaches its intended detector
contracts.protected_invariant: no arm escapes (push unblocked) and no arm is void (no detector fired)
contracts.proving_mutation: let an arm pass without blocking the push or firing a detector; escaped/void becomes non-empty
contracts.why_load_bearing: an escaped or void arm is an unproven attack

contracts.protected_invariant: reader and staging each derive exactly 16 semantic Docker sites
contracts.proving_mutation: add or drop a site; the per-workflow count is no longer 16
contracts.why_load_bearing: the 32-site universe must stay complete

contracts.protected_invariant: the global Docker universe reconciles (AGREE) at 50 sites
contracts.proving_mutation: desync the authored and derived universes; reconciliation is no longer AGREE at 50
contracts.why_load_bearing: a non-reconciling universe hides an added or moved site

contracts.protected_invariant: a mutation of either workflow file content moves the source_content_digest; the workflow file is bound
contracts.proving_mutation: stop binding the workflow file; a mutation stops moving the digest
contracts.why_load_bearing: workflow files are load-bearing content, not just paths

contracts.protected_invariant: every cross-workflow / cross-tree / retired-authorization replay is refused
contracts.proving_mutation: stop binding workflow/tree/authorization identity; a replay succeeds
contracts.why_load_bearing: a replay across workflows or trees would publish an unverified image

contracts.linked_behaviour: the API and worker executed-image manifests are distinct
contracts.protected_invariant: the staging API and worker manifests have distinct manifest digests
contracts.proving_mutation: bind both images to one identity; the manifests stop being distinct
contracts.why_load_bearing: one image's manifest must never satisfy the other's

contracts.protected_invariant: a source mutation between the API and worker builds fails the worker pre-build
contracts.proving_mutation: stop re-deriving the source at pre-build; the mutation stops failing
contracts.why_load_bearing: the pre-build check is the last gate before a build reads the tree

contracts.protected_invariant: a source mutation after establishment fails the pre-push
contracts.proving_mutation: stop re-deriving the source at pre-push; the mutation stops failing
contracts.why_load_bearing: the pre-push check is the last gate before the registry

contracts.protected_invariant: a source mutation in the window before push is refused
contracts.proving_mutation: leave an unverified window before push; the mutation reaches push
contracts.why_load_bearing: no mutation window may reach the push

contracts.protected_invariant: every staging image/tag substitution and swap is refused
contracts.proving_mutation: stop comparing intended digest/tags to the bound ones; a substitution succeeds
contracts.why_load_bearing: an image or tag substitution would publish the wrong image

contracts.linked_behaviour: workflow_graph_validator: a decoy verifier name is not an assurance step
contracts.protected_invariant: a step named like a verifier but running no real invocation fails the graph (pre-push missing)
contracts.proving_mutation: accept a display name as an assurance step; the decoy stops failing
contracts.why_load_bearing: path/name/string presence cannot satisfy assurance binding

contracts.protected_invariant: a record claiming PASS while carrying a problem does not pass
contracts.proving_mutation: make record_passes ignore the problems list; the forced record passes
contracts.why_load_bearing: the aggregate is the whole-chain verdict

contracts.linked_behaviour: either API or worker failure blocks the dual-image publication
contracts.protected_invariant: a single image's pre-push failure makes the dual publication ineligible
contracts.proving_mutation: let the push proceed on one image's PASS; a partial publication becomes eligible
contracts.why_load_bearing: no partial publication may be represented as full success
